entities.summary: Gordon "Gordie" Robertson was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Edmonton Mercurys team, which won a gold medal at the 1952 Winter Olympics in Oslo, Norway. Robertson died in October 2019 at the age of 93.
